HELICOID / SHOT LABORATORY

Trajectory first. Collision decides the hit.

1,000 shots per batch

Green: selected part · amber: another body part · red: cover/ground · grey: miss. Crosses show target-plane projections of blocked shots, not impacts behind cover. The lower diagram exaggerates sideways offsets and compresses distance to make the construction visible.

Study only—live combat is unchanged. Accuracy is a spread control, not a promised hit percentage. Aim-placement error remains at close range, so even one-metre shots can miss. Body parts use simple ellipsoid proxies; no species meshes or held weapons yet. Uniform random rotation makes changing the helicoid twist rearrange individual shots without systematically changing overall accuracy. The same seed reuses the same random inputs for comparisons.
